findings.title: cadastrar_colaborador duplicate-CPF check is an unaudited CPF oracle without dados_pessoais.ler/MFA
findings.description: cadastrar_colaborador (SECURITY DEFINER, only colaborador.criar, no MFA) checks exists(cpf=v_cpf) across ALL stores and raises 'Já existe colaborador com este CPF' before insert; forcing a later failure rolls back with no audit. Combined with cpf_mascarado (1000 candidates) recovers full CPF — same class fixed in localizar_colaborador_por_cpf.
findings.exploit_scenario: Probe 1000 candidates per employee with nome_completo 'ab' to force rollback; duplicate message reveals real CPF.
findings.recommendation: Require dados_pessoais.ler before duplicate check or generic error + audit.

findings.title: Approved documents' vencimento/competencia/nome/dates/observacoes editable by direct PATCH keeping 'aprovado'
findings.description: travar_documento doesn't lock business fields after approval; exige_vencimento only enforced at insert; observacoes (reprovação/arquivo reasons) erasable.
findings.exploit_scenario: DP extends expired ASO vencimento on approved doc; stays aprovado with original conferente.
findings.recommendation: Lock fields when status in aprovado/reprovado/arquivado or reset to recebido; enforce exige_* on update.

findings.title: status_assinatura / data_recebimento forgeable on INSERT via p_meta of documento_preparar_upload
findings.description: preparar_upload takes status_assinatura from client p_meta; UPDATE lock then protects forged value. data_recebimento backdatable.
findings.exploit_scenario: Upload unsigned warning with meta status_assinatura='assinado'.
findings.recommendation: Ignore status_assinatura from p_meta; bound data_recebimento.

findings.title: PDF active-content regex misses #xx-escaped names, compressed ObjStm, /AA /URI /SubmitForm etc.
findings.description: pdfSuspeito regex over latin1 bytes; bypassable.
findings.exploit_scenario: Upload PDF with /Open#41ction JavaScript; reviewer opens in Acrobat.

findings.title: Download filename keeps client extension, not detected type (polyglot .hta/.html/.pdf)
findings.description: nomeSeguro keeps extension; magic only first bytes; PDF filter skipped for JPEG-magic files; filename used in signed URL download.
findings.exploit_scenario: JPEG-magic file named holerite.hta downloads and runs via mshta.
findings.recommendation: Derive extension from detected type server-side.

findings.title: Non-MFA admin can disable owner's MFA requirement and revoke owner's diretoria
findings.description: definir_mfa_obrigatorio and revogar_acesso only need acesso.gerir, which non-MFA accounts (mfa_obrigatorio=false) get at AAL1.
findings.exploit_scenario: Phished rh_central password -> disable owner MFA, revoke owner's diretoria.
findings.recommendation: Require real aal2 and diretoria to change MFA flag of/revoke diretoria.

findings.title: INSERT into tarefas can forge criado_por/criado_em/chave_dedup/concluida_*
findings.description: travar_campos is BEFORE UPDATE only; tarefas_criar checks only origem='manual' and tarefa.gerir.
findings.exploit_scenario: Manager inserts task 'created by director, completed by RH' backdated.
findings.recommendation: Make trigger before insert or update and force server values on insert.

findings.title: documento_arquivar ignores sigilo level
findings.description: Only documento.arquivar per store; DP can irreversibly archive juridico docs it can't read.
findings.exploit_scenario: DP archives legal doc by UUID.

findings.title: documento_conferir lets uploader approve own document
findings.exploit_scenario: DP uploads fabricated ASO and approves it.

findings.title: atualizar_dados_pessoais unique-violation is cross-store CPF oracle
findings.description: Changing CPF to candidate raises unique violation if exists in any store.
findings.exploit_scenario: DP at store A probes store B CPFs.

findings.title: vinculo.status.alterar (no MFA) cancels/fakes termination processes requiring desligamento.gerir (MFA)
findings.description: alterar_status_vinculo allows em_desligamento<->ativo and cancels desligamentos rows.

findings.title: Invite function treats store-scoped acesso.gerir as global
findings.exploit_scenario: Store-scoped rh_central invites arbitrary accounts with service role.

findings.title: No-self-grant bypass via second invited account
findings.description: Admin invites own second mailbox and grants diretoria.
findings.recommendation: Restrict granting acesso.gerir profiles to diretoria at aal2.

findings.title: Every auth signup becomes an active usuarios row (if public signup enabled)
findings.description: Trigger inserts ativo=true for any auth.users insert.
findings.recommendation: ativo only when invited; enforce signup off.

findings.title: No upper bound on uniform quantity; int4 overflow bricks saldo and stock view
findings.description: sum(delta)::integer overflows after huge entradas; ledger immutable.
findings.exploit_scenario: Two entradas of 2147483647 break v_uniformes_estoque for all.

findings.title: 30-min idle logout not enforced after tab close
findings.description: Timer in memory; session restored from localStorage.
findings.exploit_scenario: Shared store PC reopened hours later is logged in.
findings.recommendation: Persist last activity; server session timeouts.
